entities.summary: Baba Kuhi of Shiraz was a 10th- and 11th-century Persian Sufi mystic. Probably born in Shiraz. As a young man he met the Arab poet Al-Mutanabbi and the well-known Sufi Abū ʿAbdallāh Moḥammad.
